REPRODUCIBLE LOCAL SETUP

Use the checked-in lock.

The base install includes native storage and HTTP/SDK support. Python 3.10–3.13 are CI-tested; development and model/provider extras are optional.

local install 
git clone --branch v0.8.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA.git
cd MESA
uv sync --locked --python 3.10
uv pip check
